select u.id, u.username, u.email, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.is_staff, u.is_active, u.is_superuser, u.date_joined, u.last_login, case when u.password like '!%' then 'unusable' else split_part(u.password, '$', 1) || '$' || split_part(u.password, '$', 2) end as pw_kind, (select coalesce(array_agg(g.group_id order by g.group_id), '{}') from auth_user_groups g where g.user_id = u.id) as groups, (select coalesce(array_agg(p.codename order by p.codename), '{}') from auth_user_user_permissions up join auth_permission p on p.id = up.permission_id where up.user_id = u.id) as perms from auth_user u order by u.id
